comment: Driver said he could not find unit 4B. The address label only shows the street number.
My apartment number is never included even though I entered it at checkout.
Buzzer has been broken for months and nobody can get in.
I got a text saying delivered but it was left at the wrong building.
Third time the unit number was missing from the package.
Nobody was home and there was no note about when they would return.
Would be helpful to know the delivery window so I can be at the door.
Concierge desk closes at 5pm and drivers arrive after that.
Gate was locked and the driver did not have the code.
Please just include the apartment number on the label.
I never received any notification before the driver arrived.
Package left in the rain. Would prefer a text first.
Driver called but I was in a meeting and could not answer in time.
Address was right but the building has two entrances and the driver used the wrong one.
The notification arrived after the delivery attempt had already failed.
Everything was fine once they called me.
